'''Nate Hyde Roosters cant fly either''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Nate Hyde]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13687">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13687 Roosters cant fly either], DeckTech (nate "deadbeat" hyde, 15 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13687/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13687/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018051332/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13687/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
